cards.subject: psychology
cards.hook: 40 ordinary men are told to give a stranger electric shocks up to 450 volts. How many go all the way?
cards.answer: 26 of 40, which is 65%. Every single participant went to at least 300 volts.

cards.subject: psychology
cards.hook: Participants listen to a boring phone message about a party. Half shade in shapes while listening, half do not. Afterwards all are asked for the names mentioned. IV and DV?
cards.iv: Whether the participant doodled (shaded shapes) or not
cards.dv: Number of names and places correctly recalled
cards.answer: Doodlers recalled more: a mean of 7.5 names and places against 5.8 in the control group.
